expires_today.title: One-Shots & Fast Reads by Image Comics
expires_today.long_description: We’ve teamed up with Image Comics on a massive bundle of critically acclaimed one-shots and fast reads to help you beat the heat and stay entertained this summer. Pay what you want for 50+ titles from some of the biggest writers and comic artists of all time. Rediscover Jack Kirby’s Silver Star, Grant Morrison’s occult antihero simply known as Nameless, and more! Add unique comics and soon-to-be favorites to your personal collection and support The BINC Foundation with your purchase!

expires_today.title: Mammoth Chronicles STL Mega Bundle
expires_today.long_description: Dazzle your players with this epic bundle of 131 premium fantasy STL miniatures and 9 unforgettable 5e adventures. Playtested by a dedicated community, Mammoth Chronicles is a library of short plug-and-play adventures. Featuring 131 3D-printable minis, 83 Monster Statblocks, 32 Battlemaps, 49 Magic Items, and full FoundryVTT integration, you'll never be unprepared for an upcoming game. Mammoth Chronicles was the first Kickstarter by Mammoth Factory, best known for their highly anticipated 5e Fairytales Kickstarter - Fateless. Pay what you want and help support Child's Play with your purchase!

expires_today.title: Massive Unreal Engine Bundle
expires_today.description: Create a scene with environmental assets
expires_today.long_description:
Game developers, start building your worlds in Unreal Engine with 60 modular environment kits from the creatives at Laya Design. This massive library includes fresh environments and essential assets in a variety of themes like Sci-Fi, Futurist, Tropical, Snowy, Medieval, and more! Armed with consistent style across the board, these assets easily mix and match without feeling clunky or out of place. Unlock thousands of unique modular meshes, foliage, and props to build large-scale worlds that feel truly lived in. Pay what you want for ready-to-use Unreal assets, and help support Make-A-Wish with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: The Modern Indie Game Studio Bundle by Packt
expires_tomorrow.description: Build and launch your own indie games
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Step into the world of indie game development with an all-in-one Tech Book Bundle from Packt! Make your passion a real-world career and learn how to build games using Unity, Unreal Engine 5, Godot, and Roblox. Master essential technical and creative fundamentals like C++, C#, GDScript, AI, multiplayer systems, and 3D modeling with Blender and ZBrush. Whether you’re creating your first game or refining your studio pipeline, this collection equips you with everything you need to design, develop, and launch your own games. Plus, your purchase supports the AbleGamers Foundation in building a better world for gamers with disabilities.

expires_tomorrow.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Return to New York by IDW
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Grab a slice of pizza and dive into this giant bundle of comics starring everyone’s favorite sewer-dwelling reptile warriors, the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles!! Follow the Turtles as they clean up the streets of New York City, fighting off secret police, other mutants, and the nefarious Foot while making allies in unexpected places and working together as a family! Other highlights of this bundle include the Saturday Morning Adventures volumes and one-shots inspired by the charm and pandemonium of the ’90s cartoon, Turtle Power Pack adventures for younger readers, and both volumes of collected cover art from TMNT co-creator Kevin Eastman! There’s even more mutant mayhem to discover in this bundle of nearly 50 volumes and collections, so grab it now at the price of your choosing, and support the Make-A-Wish Foundation with your purchase!

Keys Expire. Please redeem before August 12, 2027.

expires_within_72h.title: The BattleTech RPG Collection Encore by Catalyst Game Labs
expires_within_72h.long_description:
Blast off to the stars and beyond with BattleTech! This sci-fi tabletop RPG sets players down in the middle of a space opera of epic proportions, where empires rise and fall and the future of humanity rests on your shoulders. This bundle of BattleTech ebooks from Catalyst Game Labs is full of guides, rulebooks, and storylines to put you and your party on the path to universal domination! Immerse yourself in the rich lore of the galaxy, pick which faction you’ll represent in the looming conflict, hop inside a BattleMech, and choose from a vast array of combat zones in which to test your mettle. Enter a universe of possibility with this BattleTech bundle—grab it now at the price of your choice, and support Gamers Outreach with your purchase!

Codes are redeemable through the DriveThruRPG website.

There’s even more to enjoy in this fantastic indie bundle, so grab it now at the price of your choice and support Special Effect charity with your purchase!

expires_within_72h.title: The Ultimate Vegan Cookbook Bundle by Page Street Publishing
expires_within_72h.long_description: Whether you’re committed to the plant-based lifestyle or thinking about giving it a try, there’s never been a better time to go vegan—especially with this bundle of over 60 vegan cookbooks! We’ve teamed up with Page Street Publishing for a treasure trove of recipes that bring the joys of veganism right to your home kitchen. If you’re looking for Southern soul food with a vegetarian twist, scrumptious Mexican food that keeps things verde, delicious Asian-inspired meals for herbivores, or just tips on how to save while keeping your meals cruelty-free, you’ll find all of that and so much more in this bundle! Grab these cooking ebooks at the price of your choice, and help support World Central Kitchen with your purchase!

expires_within_72h.title: The Dark Horse 40th Anniversary Bundle, Presented by IGN
expires_within_72h.long_description:
Celebrate the 40th Anniversary of Dark Horse with this bundle of the publisher’s most legendary comic series, brought to you by IGN! Enjoy fabulous omnibus editions of series starring the likes of Hellboy, the Witcher, and Vampire Hunter D! Enter a new era with the superhumans and villains of Dark Horse Heroes! Rediscover classic favorites like the epic fantasy saga Elfquest, new bestsellers like Vikings-meets-Succession drama Kill All Immortals, and totally unique genre mashups like Anthony Bourdain’s Hungry Ghosts! Collected together in this bundle are 40 of Dark Horse’s best series and omnibus editions, so grab them now at the price of your choosing, and support comic creator charity Hero Initiative with your purchase!

Founded in 1986, Dark Horse is one of the industry’s leading publishers of comics, graphic novels, books, manga, and collectibles. Known for championing creator-first storytelling, Dark Horse has published landmark titles including Hellboy, Sin City, The Umbrella Academy, and Black Hammer, as well as acclaimed licensed works based on Avatar: The Last Airbender, The Witcher, The Last of Us, and Critical Role. The company also helped define manga publishing in North America with classics such as Lone Wolf and Cub, Trigun, Berserk, and Blade of the Immortal.

expires_within_72h.title: The Ultimate AI & Machine Learning Bundle
expires_within_72h.long_description:
Design the ultimate agentic sidekick, digital assistant, and beyond with the hottest AI bundle of the summer! This comprehensive course collection provides a practical journey from machine learning fundamentals to advanced agentic AI and generative AI development. You’ll master core ML concepts like regression, classification, cross-validation, decision trees, random forests, SVMs, neural networks, CNNs, and PCA through theory and hands-on labs. In a Humble Exclusive, members unlock access to Amazon Bedrock for building chatbots and more! Plus, your purchase helps support Coral Guardian!
